_meanings:
.²1 Receiving, accepting.
.²2 Receiving or accepting a donation; {#ayAcitopapanne tu nAsti dozaH pratigrahe#}
.²3 The right of receiving or accepting a donation.
.²4 The right of receiving gifts (which is a peculiar prerogative of Brāhmaṇas);
 {#aDyApanamaDyayanaM yajanaM yAjanaM taTA . dAnaM pratigrahaM cEva brAhmaRAnAmakalpayat ..#}
 <ls>Ms. 1. 88</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">4. 86</ls>; <ls>Y. 1. 118</ls>.
.²5 A gift, present, donation; {#rAjYaH pratigraho'yam#} <ls>Ś. 1</ls>; <ls>Śi. 14. 35</ls>.
.²6 A receiver (of a gift).
.²7 Kind or friendly reception; {#pratigrahAya pARqUnAM prezayAmAsa kOravAn#}

 <ls>Mb. 1. 207. 12</ls>.
.²8 Favour, grace.
.²9 Marrying; {#tatpratigrahalABAya jitvA BUpAn svayaMvare#} <ls>Bm. 1. 456</ls>.
.²10 Listening to.
.²11 The rear of an army.
.²12 A spitting-pot.
.²13 The sun near the moonʼs node.
.²14 a chamber-vessel (for sick persons).
.²15 a grasper, seizer; {#keSapratigrahaH#} = barber.
